description: This file contains the CustomerDBUtil class, which provides utility methods for database operations related to Customer objects, including validation, retrieval, insertion, updating, and deletion.

classes.name: CustomerDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class for Customer database operations, including validation, retrieval, insertion, update, and delete functions.

methods.name: validateCustomer
methods.description: Validates a customer by email and password, returning the Customer object if found.

methods.name: getAllCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Customer objects from the database.

methods.name: insertCustomer
methods.description: Inserts a new customer record into the database with provided details.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates details of a customer identified by CusID.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record based on CusID.

methods.name: updateCustomerWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates customer details excluding the image URL.
